behavior_contracts.contract: Every legacy content identity has exactly one retained, rebuilt or excluded decision; no legacy alias or missing mapping is accepted after the destructive reset.
Owned tags use lower_snake_case and a local schema_version; block entities own local state, level connections use SavedData, runtime graphs are rebuildable, and pre-0.2 data is not read.
Simulation, connection edits, tool energy use and processing mutate state only on the logical server; clients receive bounded display state.
Electricity, heat, fluids, pressure and logistics remain independent physical domains; Forge Energy is an adapter at exactly 1 J = 1 FE.
Voltage, current, resistance and stored energy conserve energy across adjacent conductors; FE conversion is explicit and instantaneous diagnostics never mutate the graph.

Connectors span at most 8 blocks and pole links at most 16; unloaded endpoints pause, chunks are never force-loaded, dimensions never connect, broken endpoints remove edges, and connections persist in SavedData.
Low/medium batteries, drill, chainsaw, piston, voltmeter and thermometer use new versioned payloads; actions and energy costs are server-validated and charging slots obey transfer limits.
Transfers happen exactly once, simulation calls have no side effects, blocked routes apply backpressure, and unloaded boundaries pause without loss or force loading.

Pneumatic payloads use bounded persisted queues, legacy weighted routing and fair first-hop selection; searches visit at most 4096 loaded nodes, blocked outputs apply backpressure, and unloaded boundaries pause without loss or force loading.
An internal item model supports right-click insertion/removal, automatic output, backpressure and horizontal auto-corners; slopes and vertical conveyors remain excluded.
Inserters preserve filtering and direction; speed and stack upgrades are the only retained upgrade items and affect only documented consumers.

The 24-entry single_block_machine_catalog uniquely binds every released single-block machine to its target ID, exact legacy source symbols, obtainability, generated guide/crafting/processing resources and existing JUnit/GameTest methods. Every survival entry has a crafting recipe; infinite_energy_source is the sole creative-only entry and has none.
Intentional creative/admin devices, including infinite energy and oil-deposit placement, remain available while internal gaps and moving placeholders never enter normal obtainable content.

All sixteen released structures preserve layout, orientation, ports, tanks, recipes, energy and form/unform rules; unloaded members pause without force loading or false teardown, and ownership prevents duplicate drops or inventory loss.
Released ore, limestone and finite oil-deposit generation feeds pumpjack, oil heating, refinery, solar, steam and storage progression without exposing internal placeholders as drops.

A pure-Java bounded Forth core, Lisp layer and Shell preserve released semantics including BIOS and user/basic/editor/asm/forth/lisp/shell media, with hard program length, memory, per-tick instruction and upload limits.

Versioned disks recover from corruption safely; computer and robot device commands are server-validated for distance, permission, chunk state, replay and budget, and unload resumes without duplication.
The legacy unrestricted TCP/SSL network card and arbitrary outbound socket access are not restored.
JEI, CraftTweaker, TConstruct and Jade remain compile-isolated and optional; a base installation never links their classes, while BuildCraft integration remains excluded.
Jade 11.13.1+forge uses an isolated plugin and server data provider for progress, energy, physical readings, tanks and multiblock state; it never exposes programs or hidden inventory.
Every retained gameplay path has symmetric en_us and zh_cn navigation, structure, recipe and fault guidance; excluded prototypes are identified as unavailable rather than documented as working.
A stable 1024-node network does not rebuild topology every tick, logistics search stops at 4096 visited nodes, and VM plus rendering work obey explicit budgets.

Legacy MCX/glTF assets remain in their original formats; static geometry and bounded BER animation share the reload-aware runtime scene loader, and formed multiblocks use a lossless invisible member projection.
